name: Azeus Systems Holdings Ltd.
summary: Azeus Systems Holdings Ltd., an investment holding company, provides IT products and services in Hong Kong, rest of Asia, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, Australia, New Zealand, North America, South America, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates in through IT Services and Azeus Products segments.
